title: Hon J Stewart Brooks, Min Alfred Brooks, Barbara and Hugh John Flemming
description: June 4, 1960: Opening of the Hugh John Flemming Bridge. Dignitaries with the blue ribbon, left to right: Hon. J. Stewart Brooks, NB Public Works, Veterans Affairs Minister Alfred Brooks, and Premier Hugh John Flemming. The little girl, Barbara, is Hugh John Flemming’s granddaughter. (Provincial Archives P155-3706)
